remarks: This townhouse has it all!! Light bright open concept main level. The beautifully updated kitchen opens to the dining room with a fabulous water view. The spacious living room has a fireplace and opens to the back deck, where you can enjoy the view, a coffee in the mornings and soak up the sun in the warm months. The foyer is spacious, has a half bath and opens to the private front patio where you can enjoy eating al fresco. Upstairs are 2 large ensuite bedrooms. Enjoy a spa-like experience in the primary bedroom, the luxury bath has a shower and jacuzzi tub. If your looking for a playroom, exercise room, or a game room, the lower level is finished with 2 more rooms! From Wilton Crest it is a quick walk to town where you can enjoy dining, shopping and the whole Wilton experience. A must see!!
